items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: That night was playing trumpet and Albert DeLong playing alto.

ctx.x: That night was playing trumpet and Albert DeLong playing alto. Mm-hmm. And Father Al played guitar. That's right.
Mm-hmm. He had six of us. Yeah. And then New Year's Eve, Pensacola, Florida, huh? That's right. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. That was Anderson's.
